Throughput measured on Apple M5 CPU (numpy vectorised CAPRISE); paper numbers are A100 GPU + per-element Python.
Phase-1: embedding dominates (128 queries: ~0.21-0.63 s vs CAPRISE ~1.5 ms); overhead 0.23-0.69% < 19% paper bound.
Phase-2: CAPRISE ~78.6k vectors/s (d=768) vs measured Paillier 2.19 vec/s (1024-bit) / 0.30 vec/s (2048-bit); paper 9x internal-consistent, cross-hardware ratios reported but not asserted (A17/A17b).
